edges.description: The expanded protein accumulates beneath the sarcolemma and in vacuoles. Misfolding is the proposed link; one hypothesis is that the longer amphipathic domain changes lipid-droplet binding and mistargets perilipin-4 to the plasma membrane.
Ubiquitinated perilipin-4 aggregates recruit the aggrephagy receptors p62/SQSTM1 and NBR1, and the scaffold WDFY3.
Continuous formation and fusion of failing aggrephagic vesicles produces progressively larger autophagic vacuoles.
Enlarging vacuoles disrupt myofibre organization and contractility, leading to atrophy.
